**L-8674, Javier Mateo Rico Méndez: not converted.** He is a politically exposed person (board member of a state-owned utility), so policy requires enhanced due diligence (EDD) before any account can be opened. Mckenzie replied that she cannot approve KYC exceptions and still wants the numbers. The customer is unhappy and wants the account open before month-end. I told him the review is in progress and that I will update him when it is complete.

The quarter count is 58 of 59 if Catrin's account counts. Javier's account is not included. Opening his account would need a Compliance-approved exception, which I cannot issue. I have recorded all of this in the handover note and closed the shift.
